description: Detach a phone number from an agent. The number is kept in your account but becomes unassigned, and the agent stops handling calls and texts on it.

agent_id.description: The ID of the agent that currently owns the number, from list_agents.

number_id.description: The ID of the number to detach, from list_numbers.

name: detach_number

outputSchema.description: Confirmation that the number was detached.

title: Detach Number from Agent
